composition_subtypes.role: Finds minimum day by binary searching answer space
Feasibility check using reverse-day greedy with offset exchange argument

payload.core_composition_summary: Binary search over days and greedy reverse simulation with exchange argument to check feasibility.
payload.rationale: Solution combines binary search on answer with a greedy feasibility check that processes days in reverse, buying sale items when possible and using an offset trick to account for full-price purchases.
